authority.roles: common owner/reactor soft pointer, extension dictionary hard owner; block and last viewport soft pointers, base and named UCS hard pointers.

bug: R13/R14 LAYOUT field and common references were accepted without role validation; out-of-range 64-bit handles were silently narrowed into 32-bit model references.
change: Require specified common and typed-tail roles and representable handle targets for AC1012 and AC1014 LAYOUT; preserve relative owner references and canonical or typed nulls, reset and invalidate on failure. Reuse existing shared bounded handle and common-tail helpers; other version behavior stays unchanged.

validation.baseline: Before the fix, hand-authored AC1012/AC1014 bodies accepted wrong roles and five-byte targets for all four typed-tail fields.
validation.controls: Hand-authored spec-layout bodies check each of the four fields against wrong roles and five-byte targets, canonical and typed nulls, all common-field roles and 64-bit bounds, relative owner, truncation, state reset and same-object corrected retry.
validation.asan: Fully instrumented library and focused test pass with AddressSanitizer.
validation.compatibility: All eight generated ACadRust R13/R14 SHAPE controls retain their prior entity and object parse-failure counts; the two resaved bound controls parse without entity/object failures and preserve destinations during the still-required output refusal.
validation.inventory: Build inventory regenerated and checked; no generated DWG/DXF committed.

limits: This guards modeled references, not full independent body-span proof or LAYOUT semantics.
No support profile or strict/partial output gate is promoted; source dictionary semantics, version-qualified target projection, physical output and independent readback remain open.
Producer drawings are generated by a peer with ACadSharp lineage and are not native AutoCAD witnesses.
